enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +7: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
True Seeing: Passive: You gain the benefit of the spell True Seeing.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +29 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Will Save +7: This item gives a +7 Resistance bonus to your Will saves.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
